1. i pulled the old blue camp bed out from behind the wardrobe, and a handful of dried grass fell onto the carpet. 2. for six summers, we dragged it into the back bedroom every july so we could fit four kids on one floor. 3. one iron leg was bent, so you always took the low side by the wall and gave me the soft cushion. 4. we stayed awake until two in the morning, making up silly games until auntie sarah banged on the floorboards. 5. but we grew up, and the summers stopped having eight long weeks in them. 6. so last night at dinner, you sat across the table in an ironed shirt, talking about fixed-rate mortgages. 7. but you kicked my shoe under the table during dessert, and didn't even look up from your plate. 8. everyone else in the room met me as an adult, but you were sitting right there on the carpet.
✍️ Caption
we spent whole summers on one floor, and now we catch up in two-hour dinners twice a year. my cousin is still the only person who knows what i looked like before i learnt to sit properly. send this to the one who shared the spare mattress with you. #childhoodmemories #nostalgia #growinguptogether #grandmashouse
